Name: Pet Roosters
Author: Endwyr
Description:
[size=4]==Adds==
Roosters
-3 Variations[/size]
[size=4]-Brown, Void, White
(If someone makes art for a Blue or Gold Rooster, I will add them in)

==Features==[/size]
-Adoptable from Marnie, like Dogs, Cats, and Turtles
-They Forage for a variety of items like: Seeds, Foragables, Geodes, and Mushrooms. Also Chicken Statues, because they love themselves.

[size=4]==Credits==
Credit to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/onlyhereforpendor]onlyhereforpendor[/url] for the Rooster Asset[/size]

[size=4]==Why This Mod?==
My partner has been playing a lot of Stardew Valley lately, and I had a burst of inspiration to pump this out really fast, because we need Roosters, and I think this is a good niche for them to fill. If you have any ideas for other items they should drop, please leave ideas.[/size]
